text:
marta_supply: Heads up — vendor sent updated terms for RMA batch `RMA-47`. They propose holding 10 units for depot repair instead of immediate full-swap. Need a quick call: accept holdback (faster credits) or require full swap (longer lead, less risk).

alice_ops: how bad is our spare pool if we let them hold 10?

ravi_hw: spare pool across us-west is at ~6 GPUs right now, us-east ~8. If those 10 leave, we'll drop below our 99th pctl capacity for a couple of hours during peak evens. Not ideal for Dedicated customers. :slightly_frowning_face:

lucas_logistics: vendor says depot-repair ETA is 14–21 days. Full-swap ETA is 28–40 days because they need new stock allocation + customs clearance. EU shipments have extra 3–5 days.

vendor_rep_jp: Correct — options from our side: (A) Depot repair: vendor retains 10 faulty units for triage/repair, sends back 10 refurbished within 14–21 days, no additional unit charge but 50% credit during hold period. (B) Full-swap: ship replacement units immediately from APAC pool, ETA 28–40 days with higher shipping/insurance. Expedited air also available for subset.

kevin_fin: what's the delta on cost if we ask for expedited air for a partial backfill?

vendor_rep_jp: Expedited air: ~$2.1k per GPU for APAC->US, ~$1.6k per GPU for APAC->EU (includes insurance). Depot repair: vendor absorbs repair labor; Redwood gets a 50% prorated usage credit while vendor holds units. Full-swap: vendor bills list price for immediate replacements, then issues credit when faulty units are returned.

alice_ops: short-term need: we must keep at least +10 spare across regions to avoid degraded autoscale. Can we do hybrid? accept depot-repair for 6 units, full-swap or expedite 4 units?

marta_supply: vendor offered hybrid: they can air-expedite up to 4 units within 5–7 days, keep 10 for depot repair but they can release earlier if triage is fast. But they want a holdback SLA: min 14 days for depot.

ravi_hw: hybrid sounds best. Prioritize nodes serving real-time low-latency routes for the expedited units. For depot-held ones, mark affected racks as degraded and shift shards.

lucas_logistics: to do expedite we need AWB and customs pre-clear. Vendor needs our broker info by EOD. I can push it through if we approve cost.

kevin_fin: propose cost split: Redwood covers expedited freight; vendor covers depot repair cost and prorated credits. If vendor misses the 14-day depot SLA, vendor refunds expedited cost. Thoughts?

vendor_rep_jp: We can accept that conditional split but need a written amendment. Also require `BrokerID` and VAT docs for EU shipments.

alice_ops: create the amendment and get legal sign. Meanwhile, initiate temporary backfill plan with existing cloud spare until replacements land.

marta_supply: filing amendment draft now. Also opening ticket with ops to tag racks. RMA details below: 
```
RMA: RMA-47
Batch IDs: B-7721, B-7722
AWB (expedite sample): JP1234567890 -> US (TBD broker)
Hold units: 10
Expedite units: 4
```

incident_bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2027 (gpu-provisioning: RMA-47 capacity risk). Assigned to @alice_ops and @ravi_hw.

ravi_hw: noted. I'll carve scheduling for the expedited units and update node allocation script.

marta_supply: ok agreed on hybrid + cost-split conditional on amendment. I'll ping legal and vendor for signatures. :thumbsup:

alice_ops: thanks — will update the oncall rotation and post a short runbook for shard moves.

kevin_fin: approved provisional budget for expedite up to $9k. Keep receipts.

vendor_rep_jp: I'll prep the amendment and AWB once you send broker info. Expect doc in ~2 hours.

marta_supply: sending broker and VAT now. Will follow up after legal signs.

alice_ops: good — target rollback plan if depot repair breached: use cloud bursting 20% capacity, notify customers with 2-hour SLA impact window.

lucas_logistics: noted, I'll stage customs paperwork for EU route.

marta_supply: closing loop — action items: 1) Legal + vendor amend, 2) Ops tag racks + runbook, 3) Finance hold expedite budget, 4) Logistics send broker/VAT, 5) Incident INC-2027 monitor. Back to you all. :white_check_mark:
